items.quote: Den Betrag erbitten wir innerhalb von 30 Tagen nach Rechnungsdatum auf unser Konto;
items.computation: Rechnungsdatum (invoice date) is 2026-11-19. The period runs 30 days after this date; per Section 187(1) BGB the day of the event is excluded, so counting starts 2026-11-20 and the 30th day is 2026-12-19. That day is a Saturday; per Section 193 BGB a deadline falling on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday moves to the next business day. 2026-12-20 is a Sunday, so the due date moves to Monday 2026-12-21, which is not a public holiday in NRW.

warnings: This is a private invoice for a hearing-aid co-payment; the letter notes that installment payment is possible by arrangement with the provider, which is an optional contractual accommodation rather than an automatic deadline change.
